data.title: Colors — Beginner · Lesson 4
data.subject: colors
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Raindrops… Got me dreaming…

[Hook]
Colors all around… Colores por todas partes
Dancing on the ground… Bailando en el suelo
Rainy morning sound… Sonido de la mañana lluviosa
Vamos a cantar… Come on, sing along.
Perla… Pearl, shining bright.

[Verse]
Good morning… Buenos días
The sky's crying, but I'm smiling.
Rojo… Red umbrella, keep me dry.
Azul… Blue rain boots, let's fly high.
Dorado claro… Light gold sunlight breaking through.
Champán… Champagne dreams in my cozy room.
Melocotón… Peach clouds up above, feeling so alive.
Salvia… Sage-colored walls, where I find my vibe.

[Hook]
Colors all around… Colores por todas partes
Dancing on the ground… Bailando en el suelo
Rainy morning sound… Sonido de la mañana lluviosa
Vamos a cantar… Come on, sing along.
Perla… Pearl, shining bright.

[Verse]
Terracota… Terracotta pots, flowers in bloom.
Marfil… Ivory dreams in my little room.
Azul cielo… Sky blue curtains, let the light in.
English… Español, let's begin again.
